evidence.quote: Application requirements: copy of passport recent medical certificate of satisfactory general health status (General Medical Certificate) high school diploma minimum of B2-intermediate level knowledge in English language

notes: The application deadline 15 May 2026 is for the fall semester of the academic year 2026-2027; it applies to international applicants (the programme is taught in English and applications are via DreamApply). The tuition fee of 3200 EUR/semester is the fee for self-financed students outside the EU/EEA. The Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship is available but is not a tuition of 0.

note.fr: Un entretien oral (examen d'entrée) est requis. Préparez la communication en anglais, les mathématiques, l'informatique, vos projets et votre motivation. L'examen d'entrée coûte 100 EUR (non remboursable) et des frais de candidature de 79 EUR s'appliquent.
note.en: An oral entrance examination is required. Prepare English communication, mathematics, computer science, your projects and motivation. The entrance exam fee is 100 EUR (non-refundable) and an application fee of 79 EUR applies.

evidence.quote: Application fee: 79 Euro (non-refundable) Entrance Exam fee: 100 Euro (non-refundable)
